song_craft: Hand-and-emblem song (10v): boon-enacts → uproots → skull-borne → pretext-commands → wild-sounds → outside-mirrored → thunder-borne → tamed → bent-points → everywhere-abode. Glory in gear.

lines: By the boon hand, glory-giving enacted;
principle-fixed — by glory-stains untouched ever.
l4.sanskrit_cite: varadena pāṇinā tvaṃ viśvavibhūtipradatvam abhinayasi na khalu paratattvaniṣṭho vibhavamalaiḥ spṛśyate jātu

lines: By fearlessness, world-fears uprooted, shown always;

there, by supreme waking borne — thus You show.

in knowing's single mass. By skull-staff-bone pretext — command.
